🫏 New post ready 📚 List · love · 8 slides “tiny ways someone makes sharing a life feel easy” 📝 Slides
1. tiny ways someone makes sharing a life feel easy 2. hanging your clean towel over the warm radiator while you're in the shower, without needing to be asked. 3. leaving the long charging cable on your side of the couch, even when their own phone is sitting at four percent. 4. scraping the frost off your windscreen before seven in the morning, so you don't freeze your fingers. 5. taking the heavy paper bags from your hands at the car boot, and acting like they just wanted something to hold. 6. saying we can leave whenever you want before you even ring the doorbell at the party, and meaning every word. 7. making the phone call to cancel the dinner plans, so you never have to be the one who looks difficult. 8. save this for a crowded day, and keep it for the one who makes coming home easy.
✍️ Caption
nobody tells you how much of love is just someone taking the friction out of a tuesday. a good partner doesn't fix your whole world, they just make sure the rooms you share don't ask for extra effort. save this for a hectic day when you need to remember the quiet care waiting for you. #relationshipquotes #quotesaboutlove #partnership #couples
